name: unsafe fn from_parts_in (ptr : NonNull < T > , length : usize , capacity : usize , alloc : A) -> Self
rule: Allocation sources other than `Vec<T, A>` are permitted if all of the following hold: `ptr` is currently allocated via `alloc`; the alignment of `T` equals the allocation alignment; the size of `T` multiplied by `capacity`, in bytes, equals the allocation size; `length` is no greater than `capacity`; the first `length` values are properly initialized values of type `T`; `capacity` fits the layout size with which `ptr` was allocated; and the allocated size in bytes is no larger than `isize::MAX`.
api: impl < T , A : Allocator > alloc::vec::Vec < T , A > { unsafe fn from_parts_in (ptr : core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < T > , length : usize , capacity : usize , alloc : A) -> Self }
